blocks.text: the revised version of the short-term rentals after it was tabled on August 25th. If you would like, I can kind of go through an overview of what was changed on it. Okay, so besides the language and formatting revisions, which you'll find throughout the code, the following things were amended. So 1131.01 , allowing for one application to be submitted if multiple short-term rentals are located within the same short-term rental premises. The reasoning behind this was to avoid the multiple fees for the same property. 11-3101C was amended, changing the renewal process to be in two-year increments instead of one, to once again take away some of the hardship and fees from the short-term rental applicants, but to still maintain diligence and checking to ensure safety and code requirements are being upheld. 113103A6, the section on on-street public parking was omitted. The original thought behind this was to try and prevent all the street parking from being taken up by short-term renters. However, we cannot prevent or enforce parking restrictions on public right-of-ways. 113103A8, a provision was added that allows applicants to submit background checks that had previously been carried out within the past 12 months. This falls in line with our current vendor requirements, which allow for this provision. 113104D, appropriate warnings to tenants or renters regarding the existence of security cameras must be posted on the premises. 113104H, a provision was added stating that short-term rentals shall only be rented to individuals 18 years or older. 11-3105E, a provision was added to grounds for denial stating the short-term rental or short-term rental premises does not have adequate fire protection or otherwise presents a risk of bodily injury by way of fire. 11-6101, definitions were added for short-term rental and short-term rental premises.

blocks.text: I have one for NNCO for publications of ordinances for $106.97.

blocks.speaker: SPEAKER_06
blocks.text: Mr. President, I'd like to make a motion to pay the bill. Second.

blocks.speaker: SPEAKER_08
blocks.text: I have a motion and a second to pay the bill. All those in favor, please signify by saying aye. Aye. All those opposed, same sign. Bill is paid. No need for an executive session.

blocks.speaker: SPEAKER_06
blocks.text: will now entertain a motion to adjourn mr president i like to make that motion we adjourn

blocks.text: second a motion a second to adjourn all those in favor please signify by saying aye all those opposed same sign please remember to sign your legislation before you leave this evening thank you
